PreviewBanner reads daisyUI role tokens and follows light and dark schemes on a daisyUI site.
A site without daisyUI sets the five properties itself because no literal fallback exists.
Draft and ended states use distinct role tokens; only the ended state links, with the info ink and a focus ring.
Five named custom properties override the banner, each replacing the default in both states, pointing at the site's own tokens.
Snippet setting three preview properties on the root to daisyUI tokens and a zero radius.
A property declared on the root or an ancestor always wins because the banner reads through var and declares none itself.
Section heading.
The link's token is the only credential; the loader ignores cookies and both editor and access locals.
Every response, refusals included, sets no-store, noindex, and locked-down referrer and frame headers.

The ended copy never claims the draft went live, since a discarded edit reaches the same state.
Every other failure answers an identical uninformative 404 with no signal distinguishing expired from never existed.
